context: Hiroshi-boss reviews a schedule with Ren.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business scheduling; vocabulary (先ほど/時刻/とおり/午前/前回) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 先ほどの件は、どうなったかね?
lines.en: How did the matter from earlier go?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 前回の予定どおり、進んでいます。
lines.en: It's going as last time's schedule.
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 訪問の時刻は、いつかね?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 午前十一時の予定です。
lines.style: precise young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 先ほど、先方から連絡はあったかね?
lines.en: Did the other party contact us earlier?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、予定どおりだと先ほど確認しました。
lines.en: Yes, I confirmed just now it's as scheduled.
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 前回より、早く着くようにな。
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 午前のうちに、向かいます。
lines.en: I'll head over in the morning.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
